name: Strands Agents
description: Builds production agent harnesses in Python or TypeScript with a model-driven agent loop, pluggable model providers, MCP tools, hooks, guardrails, and multi-agent patterns.

skills.name: Run Agent Loops
skills.description: Runs a model-driven agent loop that plans, calls tools, and iterates until the task completes, in Python or TypeScript.

skills.name: Swap Model Providers
skills.description: Points the same agent code at Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, or a custom provider without rewriting logic.

skills.name: Connect MCP Tools
skills.description: Loads tools from MCP servers or from plain Python and TypeScript functions, and lets the agent invoke them during a run.

skills.name: Intercept Steps With Hooks
skills.description: Hooks into any step of the agent loop to log, validate, or redirect decisions, and applies guardrails before actions run.

skills.name: Compose Multi-Agent Patterns
skills.description: Coordinates multiple agents with built-in multi-agent patterns, structured output, and bidirectional streaming support.
